concept: 아직 반영된 게 아니라면 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 반영되었다면 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

prompt_en: In a ceramic kiln studio beside a rain-glossed loading court, an adult woman pauses at a cooled closed kiln during the final quarter-turn of its small brass vent crank. Make a tactile analog garment-design editorial, with warm rust cloth and charcoal knit against ceramic machinery and wet reflections. Her visible face and short dark bob with fine separated bangs follow the supplied portrait as appearance guidance. Her head faces the camera with both eyes and her entire face readable. She stands upright next to the kiln, her right hand wrapping the waist-height crank handle and her right elbow below the chest; her free left hand rests against her own thigh. She wears a rust-colored opaque one-shoulder midi dress over an opaque charcoal high-neck long-sleeve top. For the rust dress, one garment support passes over a single shoulder of the adult subject: its broad left band joins the bodice. The right shoulder remains covered by the separate charcoal top; the opposite shoulder is outside the same asymmetrical neckline edge of the rust dress, and the diagonal garment edge and its attachment remain visibly continuous. Its rust fabric covers her torso through the calves. Across this dress, the garment follows the adult torso and hip contour with local hanging ease; continuous folds bridge between contact areas rather than compressing every body plane; the hem and side edges remain visible as a separate textile layer. A few small supporting gathers converge at the stitched left waist side seam while larger center folds hang freely. Frame vertically from the complete head to both flat planted boots, with the calf hem clearly inside the picture and the facial features still readable, at chest-height and nearly frontal toward her left side. The kiln's ceramic door, attached vent housing and connected brass crank remain beside the adult and her turning hand. Soft frontal window daylight and a warm work lamp retain fabric weave, natural skin texture and restrained fine film grain.
